## Work with me

I turn data into rapid, decision-ready evidence for research organisations, combined authorities, local government and others. 15 years’ experience building products and reproducible tools for complex policy and research questions.

I'm always trying to find new ways to understand and show what the data *means*, build the pipelines to interrogate it, and use my economics/politics to put it in context. 

I can produce rapid work because I've built the open-code foundation for it. Working with others, I'm continually making those foundations better.

**Available for commissions - happy to talk through ideas. Get in touch.**

Examples of my outputs (a lot more [below](http://localhost:6870/#my-work)):

- **Rapid local-economy diagnostics**: sector structure, specialisation, productivity and growth narrative, produced in weeks. Examples: [report](https://danolner.github.io/RegionalEconomicTools/quarto_docs/LeedsBradford_overview_May2025.html) on economic collaboration across Leeds & Bradford, [sector analysis 3-pager](https://www.southyorkshire-ca.gov.uk/getmedia/75e687c5-a6b5-40c1-ad0c-73344f64f084/SYMCA_Plan-for-Good-Growth_analysis.pdf) for SYMCA [Plan for Good Growth](https://www.southyorkshire-ca.gov.uk/getmedia/0a501851-f673-4337-972a-43608d62fff9/SYMCA-PlanForGoodGrowth_Final.pdf), Yorkshire & Humber [sector portraits](https://danolner.github.io/RegionalEconomicTools/quarto_docs/Yorkshire_n_Humber_sectors_Nov2025.html) for Yorkshire Universities.
- **Firm-level economic intelligence**: Companies House data made open using [my build](https://github.com/DanOlner/companieshouseopen), cross-referenced with official sources. Examples: [SY Dashboard](https://danolner.github.io/companieshouseopen/webmap/) sector drill-down / export, spatial pipeline and analysis in [Resilient AI Adoption in Manchester](https://manchesterdigitalstrategy.com/resilient-ai-adoption-in-greater-manchester) (Manchester City Council, 2026). Also used in the Leeds/Bradford collab and Y&H sector portraits. 
- **R training and capacity-building**: I've trained PhD students, local authority analysts and policymakers. [See below](#teaching-r-workshops-and-quantitative-methods) for more, including links to recent ONS workshops.

**When the analysis you need doesn't have a tool yet**: you'll see from the [projects below](#project-highlights), I build whatever systems I need to get to the answers. I build data pipelines from hard-to-wrangle sources, simulation and modelling frameworks (including many spatial models) and interactive tools for non-technical users. **If you have any larger build ideas/needs, let's talk it through.**
